validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel><data id="names" expr="['a', 'b']"/></datamodel>
  <final id="a">
    <onentry>
      <foreach array="names" item="class" index="i"><log expr="i"/></foreach>
    </onentry>
  </final>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `<foreach item>` must be a variable name, but `class` is a reserved word in ECMAScript
notes: `<foreach>` assigns each array element (`item`) and its position (`index`) to a variable with this name; an ECMAScript reserved word such as `class` can never name a variable
diagnostics.help: rename the loop variable, for example `classItem`, and use that name inside the loop
